name: Cheapest Floor Upgrade That Still Passes a Kirkland Buyer Inspection
title-tag: Cheapest Floor Upgrade That Passes a Kirkland Inspection
meta-description: A $1.99/sq ft screen and recoat makes sound Kirkland hardwood show like new in one day. What inspectors flag, what buyers punish, and where the money goes.
post-summary: October 30, 2026 · Inspectors flag damage; buyers punish dullness — and for most Kirkland sellers the fix is a $1.99/sq ft screen and recoat, one day of work that makes sound hardwood photograph like new. The four-rung spending ladder, a symptom table for which rung you need, and the pre-sale floor spends that never pay back.
